scope: Recover the omitted change-bound plan for the exact preserved documentation-only verified phone-delivery checkpoint; no runtime or historical evidence edits.

defects.rootCause: The documentation-only checkpoint was committed without its mandatory matching engineering plan.
defects.detectionGap: Later local qualification used that checkpoint as base, skipping its omitted record; hosted main-base qualification correctly refused it.
defects.regression: Pin exact commit, single changed path, original Git blobs, digest and supplemental plan hash; altered source, modes and plans remain denied.
defects.historicalPrevention: Qualify the full remote-base history before the next push, including every checkpoint, and create matching plans before future commits.
